briefdescription.para: Blocking (pqxx pool) and coroutine (AsyncDbClient/Drogon) implementations of DatabaseController.

detaileddescription.para: Synchronous methods funnel through the executer template; coroutine methods each obtain the async client, short-circuit when it is absent, and translate Drogon busy errors into DatabaseBusy for 503 responses.

WHY THIS FILE MATTERS IN THE SERVER: This is the lowest layer that actually touches PostgreSQL. All the shared machinery lives here: lazy, thread-safe creation of the connection pool, the single executer template that acquires a connection and runs blocking SQL, and the async family that runs on Drogon's IO loop. By converting "busy" into a dedicated exception, this file lets the HTTP layer answer 503 with Retry-After instead of treating overload as a broken query.
